title: funcd site kind: flow
cli: funcdctl | applies the Site @gray site: Site | image, ingress @green img: Bundle | an OCI image @gray rec: Site reconciler | once per spec change @green bucket: Bucket | files under the digest @green route: Route | named after the Site @blue browser: Browser | HTTP @gray edge: Edge | static files, no worker @blue
cli > site > rec img > rec: resolved to a digest rec > bucket: copies, index last rec > route: writes browser > edge > route route > bucket: serves from
